title: Restore dependencies independently of next-best cache entries
goal: Resolve an unavailable nonfloating minimum from declared sources, diagnose cache-only intermediate version differences and preserve exact cached requests for direct and transitive dependencies.

selectionNotes: Target-11 edition with actual SDK 10.0.402 and 11 RC2 comparison; the exact eight .NET 10 foundations are unchanged.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Runtime required by the executed net11 consumer; SDK packing/restoring itself is a separate requirement.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: SDK 11 implements the new NuGet behavior; exact verification uses RC2, compared with SDK 10.0.402.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Original current consumer/library uses C# 15; NuGet identity and version selection are language independent.

packageAssets: Original local Cwmglas.Station.Readings/2.0.0, 2.3.0, 2.5.0 and 2.8.0 with lib/net10.0 or lib/net11.0/StationReadings.dll; Cwmglas.Station.Survey/1.0.0 requests minimum Readings/2.3.0.
platforms: Actual Windows x64 execution; no claim of other OS execution.
prerequisites: Installed SDK/runtime 10 and 11 for the comparison; PowerShell 7 for the local checks.
Separate explicit local sources, cache, CLI home and consumer directories per scenario; disable automatic global-tools PATH integration before first use.
constraints: No public publication, account writes, shared-cache clearing, PATH or persistent environment changes.
Package source policy, actual selected assets and SDK analysis are separate decisions.
Scope: inclusive nonfloating minimum requests; floating versions, general ranges and fallback-folder execution are unverified.
Exact cached minimum reuse remains valid; next-best cache exclusion is not a blanket cache disable.

Measured default cases generate lock files: direct approximations emit NU1601; transitive approximations emit no NU1601/NU1603. A fresh legacy-resolver control with lock generation disabled emits NU1603.
stabilityLimitations: Not an experimental API; actual SDK 11 RC2 evidence is not final GA verification. PIN-959/PIN-963 remain open.

evidence.scope: Actual original library compilation with no external dependency. Consumer behavior is recorded separately.

Actual direct/transitive default cache/source selection and execution, NU1601/default transitive silence, new NU1102, exact-cache and uncached cases, existing-source repair, plus explicit legacy-resolver NU1603 diagnostic control. Default cases generate lock files; the NU1603 control explicitly disables lock generation.
